summary: The toy 3D style is mostly maintained with bright lighting and clear character designs. However, several shots suffer from floating objects, overlapping text elements, and minor proportion mismatches.

clean: shot 0: Character holding the gourd correctly with floating ball hands.
shot 9: Character drinking with bombilla at the mouth and gourd below chin.
unclean: shot 6: Thermos and mate are placed floating on a standalone pedestal out of context.
shot 12: Icons comparing thermos and phone floating on pedestals in a surreal beach setting.

clean: Consistent color palette and toy-like textures across backgrounds and characters.
Clear caption placement at the top and headline cards in appropriate zones.
unclean: shot 3: Text cards overlap slightly with background elements.
shot 11: UI checklist boxes obscure the background completely.

issues.problem: Thermos and mate shown isolated on a wooden pedestal instead of being held by the character.
issues.fix: Ensure the character is holding the thermos and mate as described in the audio.

issues.problem: Checklist UI graphic covers the entire scene background abruptly.
issues.fix: Integrate UI lists as floating graphic overlays with transparency or keep the character visible.

learnings.rule: Do not isolate props onto abstract pedestals when the narrative is about the character carrying them.
Always keep floating ball hands visibly attached via perspective and actively gripping props.
